jp-twentyninth-riken-property-plan.summary: RIKEN’s October 2025 project plan identifies a separate proposed property at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi, south of the existing Fugaku facilities. Its eastern, western and southern boundaries face Minatojima Roads 44, 45 and 41. The same address appears in the October 2026 tender. The Atlas marker locates this proposed property approximately; it is not the existing Fugaku building or a confirmed footprint of the new building.

additions.distinctness_review: All serialized fields screened across 432 sites, 458 projects, 2339 evidence and 231 original records plus identity mapping. No identity/source collision or geometry-envelope overlap. Nearest recorded site is Kobe Former Conveyor Tunnel Data Center at 15437.6 m. See dedup-review.json.

locator.identity_review: The October 13, 2026 RIKEN notice explicitly procures a new building for Fugaku NEXT at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi, Kobe. The public October 2025 plan identifies that same named address and outlines the proposed southern property on municipal maps and an aerial inset, between Minatojima Roads 44, 45 and 41. The August 2026 requirements retain the address and road descriptions. The 2025 target-property outline is registered to GSI photo tiles with 15 distinct matched controls. The marker is inside that southern proposed property, not the existing Fugaku building to its north. Revised detailed technical documents are behind vendor registration and were not accessed; the current exact-address bridge supports an approximate parent-property marker, not a final new-building footprint.
locator.precision: Approximate interior marker for the proposed Fugaku NEXT parent property at 7-1-1 Minatojima-minamimachi, south of the existing Fugaku facilities. Derived from RIKEN’s historical property outline, with the address reconfirmed in the October 13, 2026 tender. The final building footprint is unknown; this is not a surveyed position.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Source-plan drawing, imagery acquisition date and orthorectification, geodetic-frame approximation, and actual property boundaries have no complete error budget. Image-fit residuals and coordinate decimal places do not establish ground accuracy. EPSG:9936 is an approximate WGS84-ensemble bridge with no epoch-specific correction; output is rounded to four decimals.
